# Vendored dependency

- `fflate-0.8.2.js`: unmodified browser ESM distribution of fflate 0.8.2.
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fflate@0.8.2/esm/browser.js
- Upstream: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate/tree/v0.8.2
- License: MIT, retained in `fflate-LICENSE.txt`.
- Used for PC multi-image ZIP exports with `level: 0` (STORE). No runtime CDN request.
- Upstream source formatting is retained; application files follow project CRLF rules.
